sentence: This project studies how terminal selectors set neuronal identity and wiring patterns between similar neurons in the fruit fly visual system.
This project tries to find out how inhibitors of signaling change the tumor immune microenvironment and the response to therapy in glioblastoma.
This project uses mouse models to study how mutations in one gene cause motor neuron degeneration.
This project builds hardware and software tools that measure single cells and tissues in several ways at once.
This project tries to find out how to fix stem cell and wound healing problems in the diabetic cornea.
This project studies how drug combinations that target protein complexes controlling gene expression act against acute myeloid leukemia.
This project studies how circular RNAs drive the spread of melanoma.
This project tests how photothermal therapy with gold nanoparticles changes immune responses in lymphoma models.
This project studies how HIV proviruses with leader defects evade immune clearance and affect viremia.
This project studies how a C-type lectin receptor affects microglia and Alzheimer's disease in mice and human stem cell-derived cells.
This project studies how foamy macrophages form and handle cholesterol in atherosclerosis.
This project builds a machine learning model and optical tests on neurons to predict whether antisense oligonucleotide drugs cause toxicity.
This project studies how metastatic cancer cells in lymph nodes suppress immune responses and how to overcome that.
This project studies how maternal proteins and mRNA are stored in the cytoplasm during oogenesis and decoded after fertilization.
This project builds mouse models, xenograft models and stem cell lines to support cancer research.
This project studies how age and inflammation drive intervertebral disc degeneration.
This project provides bioinformatics support and builds computational tools for analyzing large, complex datasets in cancer research.
This project studies how digital mobile technologies can help prevent and control tuberculosis transmission, infection and disease.
This project builds computational methods that use machine learning and molecular simulation to design compounds that bind to a protein.
